content: Individuals diagnosed with type 1 diabetes are at an increased risk of developing other autoimmune diseases. These conditions include Hashimoto's thyroiditis, Graves' disease, celiac disease, Addison’s disease, and vitiligo. Additionally, autoimmune syndromes such as Autoimmune Polyendocrine Syndrome Type 1 (APS-1) and Immune Dysregulation, Polyendocrinopathy, Enteropathy, X-linked Syndrome (IPEX) are associated with type 1 diabetes. These syndromes are caused by genetic mutations in regulatory genes, such as FOXP3 and AIRE.
